facts.fact: The ICT minister told the Senate defence committee that the National Council for AI launched the second edition of the National AI Strategy in 2025, built on six pillars: governance, technology, data, infrastructure, ecosystem and skills.

The minister said the National Council for AI, created in 2019, launched the first edition of the strategy in 2021 and the second in 2025; the council was renamed National Council for AI, Quantum Computing and Emerging Technologies.
